takeaway: Osteoarthritis is degenerative: worn cartilage with a narrowed joint space, osteophytes, sclerosis and bone cysts.

question.text: A 60-year-old woman has had gradual pain and swelling in both knees for 2 years. X-ray: reduced joint space, sclerosis, cysts and osteophytes. What is the likely diagnosis?
question.say: A sixty-year-old woman has had pain and swelling in both knees, of gradual onset, for two years. The X-ray shows a reduced joint space, sclerosis, cysts and osteophytes. What is the likely diagnosis?

lines.text: Gradual pain and swelling in both knees for 2 years.
lines.say: This woman has had gradual pain and swelling in both knees for two years.

lines.text: Her knees are tender, with excess synovial fluid.
lines.say: Her knees are tender, with excess synovial fluid and synovial thickening.

lines.text: The golden spikes are osteophytes: new bone at the joint margins.
lines.say: (laugh) The golden spikes are osteophytes, new bone forming at the joint margins.

lines.text: The cartilage is worn, so the joint space is narrowed.
lines.say: The cartilage is worn away, so the joint space is narrowed.

lines.text: Beneath it the bone shows sclerosis.
lines.say: Beneath it, the bone shows sclerosis.

lines.text: And there are cysts in the bone.
lines.say: And there are cysts in the bone.

lines.text: Remember: osteophytes, sclerosis and cysts with a narrow joint space mean osteoarthritis.
lines.say: Remember: osteophytes, sclerosis and cysts with a narrow joint space mean osteoarthritis.
